title: Waves breaking in the stellar lagoon
caption: The centre of the Lagoon Nebula, imaged by the Hubble Space Telescope
celestial: Lagoon Nebula · constellation Sagittarius · about 5000 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESA/Hubble press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: This Hubble close-up looks into the centre of the Lagoon Nebula, Messier 8, where delicate structures have formed in the gas. The blue-white flare at the upper left is not part of the nebula at all. It is stray light from a bright star lying just beyond the edge of the frame.

The shapes in the gas come from an encounter between young stars and the cloud of hydrogen they were born from. The newborn stars give off powerful radiation, and as it strikes the surrounding hydrogen it sculpts the gas into fine, delicate features.

Each colour is assigned to a particular kind of light. Red marks glowing hydrogen, green marks ionised nitrogen, and blue marks light through a yellow filter. Separating these gases lets astronomers see where different processes are happening in the cloud, and how the young stars are reshaping their surroundings.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (3.27 x 1.67 arcminutes) and distance (5000 light years), the frame spans roughly 4.8 × 2.4 light-years. Its light set out about 5,000 years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: This image comes from Hubble's Advanced Camera for Surveys. Glowing hydrogen (F658N) is shown in red, ionised nitrogen (F660N) in green, and light through a yellow filter (F550M) in blue.
understand.eye: The narrow filters isolate the glow of specific gases, so the colours map chemistry rather than what an eye would see.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

explore: The picture was made with the Wide Field Channel of Hubble's Advanced Camera for Surveys, with exposures of 1560, 1600 and 400 seconds. It covers about 3.3 by 1.7 arcminutes of sky.
alt: Delicate structures of glowing gas at the centre of a nebula, with a blue-white flare of light at the upper left.
